description: This file defines the Image module for HTMLPurifier, providing basic image embedding and configuration setup for image attributes such as src, height, width, alt, and longdesc. It includes methods to setup image element attributes and applies transformations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Image
classes.description: Represents the Image module in HTMLPurifier, handling image element creation and attribute configuration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the image element, setting attributes like src, height, width, alt, and longdesc based on configuration settings and applying required transformations.
